svg.title: SmartReco platform overview
svg.desc: How SmartReco turns learner behaviour and stated career goals into recommended courses: the two user flows, the nine-phase AI agent, the four AI principles, key figures, and the technology stack.
svg.text: An AI agent decides what each learner should study next — and shows its evidence for why.
1 · How a learner reaches a recommendation
Two independent routes into the same catalogue

g.text: “I’m a QA engineer, I want to be an AI engineer”
free text, matched to a 628-skill vocabulary
what counts · what’s missing · what order
each step assumes only what the last one taught
chosen by the skill graph, never by the model

svg.text: 2 · The nine phases the agent runs
Only two of them spend money on a model

g.text: not good enough — search again, max 2

svg.text: 3 · The four principles the system is built on

g.text: The model never picks a course
A career plan is the most consequential thing
this platform says to anyone. It is computed
from the skill graph and handed to the model
as settled fact. It writes only the prose.
Copy may cite only the real catalogue and the
learner’s own actions. A course that was never
offered is dropped; 35 always-on checks block
job guarantees, fake scarcity, invented prices.
Eleven gates run cheapest-first before any
model call, and every skip records its reason.
generation scored by an LLM judge, prompts
versioned per run, and the injection attacks
